description: This source file contains functions for configuring and retrieving user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch hardware. It includes functions to set (`rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector`) and get (`rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector`) field selector configurations, handling register access and parameter validation.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Sets a user-defined field selector in the hardware by configuring specific register bits based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specified user-defined field selector from hardware registers.
